reasoning_content:
The key blockers:
1. Backend image build requires GITHUB_TOKEN (classic PAT with read:packages) to pull packages from GitHub. No token available in environment.
2. app/.npmrc @sw-code:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com — needs auth token too.

Let me check .npmrc fully and whether pnpm install can work without token (public packages?).

Let me first install prerequisites: node, pnpm, just. Then run `just doctor` to see.

Let me check network access.
